name: [SOC/UEBA] USB exfiltration – many files copied after hours in one day
query:
from soc-events-cert metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.dataset=="cert.file" and event.offhours==true
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1days, @timestamp) | stats event_count=count() by timebucket, user.name
| where event_count >= 10
description: USB exfiltration – many files copied after hours in one day – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA

name: [SOC/UEBA] Many external emails with attachments in one day
query:
from soc-events-cert metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.dataset=="cert.email" and email.external_recipients>=1 and email.attachments>=1
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1days, @timestamp) | stats event_count=count() by timebucket, user.name
| where event_count >= 8
description: Many external emails with attachments in one day – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA

name: [SOC/UEBA] After-hours USB + very rare website on the same day (possible data exfiltration)
query:
from soc-events-cert metadata _id, _index, _version | where (event.dataset=="cert.device" and event.action=="Connect" and event.offhours==true) or (event.dataset=="cert.http" and url.org_popularity<0.01)
| eval event_type=case(event.dataset=="cert.device" and event.action=="Connect" and event.offhours==true, "cert_usb_offhours", event.dataset=="cert.http" and url.org_popularity<0.01, "cert_rare_domain")
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1days, @timestamp) | stats event_type_count=count_distinct(event_type) by timebucket, user.name
| where event_type_count >= 2
description: After-hours USB + very rare website on the same day (possible data exfiltration) – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA

name: [SOC/UEBA] Very rare website + .exe copied to USB on the same day (possible spyware install)
query:
from soc-events-cert metadata _id, _index, _version | where (event.dataset=="cert.http" and url.org_popularity<0.01) or (event.dataset=="cert.file" and file.extension=="exe")
| eval event_type=case(event.dataset=="cert.http" and url.org_popularity<0.01, "cert_rare_domain", event.dataset=="cert.file" and file.extension=="exe", "cert_exe_to_removable")
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1days, @timestamp) | stats event_type_count=count_distinct(event_type) by timebucket, user.name
| where event_type_count >= 2
description: Very rare website + .exe copied to USB on the same day (possible spyware install) – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA

name: [SOC/UEBA] Job searching + files copied to USB on the same day (leaver taking data)
query:
from soc-events-cert metadata _id, _index, _version | where (event.dataset=="cert.http" and url.category=="job") or (event.dataset=="cert.file" and file.extension rlike ".+")
| eval event_type=case(event.dataset=="cert.http" and url.category=="job", "cert_job_search", event.dataset=="cert.file" and file.extension rlike ".+", "cert_file_copy")
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(1days, @timestamp) | stats event_type_count=count_distinct(event_type) by timebucket, user.name
| where event_type_count >= 2
description: Job searching + files copied to USB on the same day (leaver taking data) – converted from Sigma by pySigma.
author: SOC/UEBA
